headline: 15-candidate portfolio commercially re-mapped across 5 medical markets. key_finding: P-13 (Neuromorphic Failure Predictor) is ranked #2 after P-01 because it can reach a buyer with $0-5K of evidence (public dataset + model training) in 1-2 months. The portfolio optimizer recommends parallel-pushing P-01 (high-value, $7-10K bench) and P-13 (quick win, $0-5K dataset) rather than spending all resources on P-01 alone.
